status: All three editions published; phone and Garmin public download checksums verified; website checked live
scope: Mainland Norway and coastal islands; excludes Svalbard, Jan Mayen and Norwegian dependencies. Bounds select from the Norway source extract, not neighbouring countries.
overlapPolicy: Include full basemap, contours, hillshade and grid coverage in both adjacent editions. Use the same source snapshot and shared cartography. No fading or reduced-detail border strips.

editions.label: Southern Norway
editions.coverageDescription: Southern coast through Trondheim; includes Oslo, Stavanger, Bergen, Hardangervidda, Jotunheimen and the southern fjords.

editions.label: Central Norway
editions.coverageDescription: Trondheim, Trondelag and the Helgeland coast through Bodo.

editions.label: Northern Norway
editions.coverageDescription: Bodo, Lofoten, Vesteralen, Tromso and Finnmark through North Cape and Kirkenes.

buildRequirements: Check all three crops against the complete Norway source outline, including outlying coastal islands, before building.
Choose and verify northern-latitude elevation coverage; keep elevation provenance and licence notices with each edition.
Generate overlapping terrain and grid from consistent settings and sources so neighbouring maps agree.
Assign independent regional profiles, output paths and Garmin identities before enabling builds.
Validate map detail on both sides of each join and measure final download sizes after packaging.
